gloss: post-dating (writing a future date on a document)

definitions.gloss: post-dating; writing a future date on a document
definitions.explanation: The practice of putting a date later than the current one on a document — most commonly a check or a contract — so that it takes effect from that later date. Used in banking, accounting, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {先日付|さきづけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧。
⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{先日付|さきづけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To draw up the contract with a future date.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{先日付|さきづけ}⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: We received a post-dated check from our business partner.

examples.japanese: {先日付|さきづけ}⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{現金化|げんきんか}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In some cases, a post-dated check cannot be cashed until the date written on it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (ahead; later in time) and ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧ (date; dating), with rendaku changing ひづけ to づけ. Literally "an ahead-in-time date." The antonym is {後日付|あとひづけ} or {遡及|そきゅう}⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧ (back-dating).

USAGE:
A specialized business and banking term. It appears most often in {先日付|さきづけ}⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧ (post-dated check), a common practice in Japan where a supplier accepts a check dated for a future settlement day. Also used for contracts, invoices, and receipts when the effective date is intentionally set later than the signing date. Rare in everyday conversation — outside of business contexts, people simply say ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先日付|さきづけ}⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧: post-dated check
- {先日付|さきづけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to issue with a future date
- {先日付|さきづけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧: a post-dated contract
- {先日付|さきづけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to accept post-dating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後日付|あとひづけ}・⟦バック→バック：12378_bakku⟧⟦デート→デート：03861_deeto⟧: back-dating — the opposite practice, writing an earlier date than the current one
- ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧: date — the neutral general term
- {約束手形|やくそくてがた}: promissory note — a related instrument, but with its own legal framework
- {期日|きじつ}⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧: specifying a due date — a broader concept that covers post-dating and other date-related arrangements
